footer.built: Built for private banks and independent wealth managers.

home.subtext: Valore brings together positions across all custodians into one unified dashboard — built for independent wealth managers and private banks who demand discretion.

pillars.languagesSub: EN FR ES DE IT PT

privacy.heading: No data ever leaves your machine.
privacy.body: Your clients' positions, portfolios, and personal information are processed and stored exclusively on your device. Valore requires no internet connection to function and maintains no servers, accounts, or telemetry. What is private remains private.
privacy.bullet1: No account required to use the application
privacy.bullet2: No outbound network requests during operation
privacy.bullet3: Data stored locally in an encrypted, portable format
privacy.bullet4: Works fully offline — air-gapped environments supported

home.quote: Private wealth deserves private software — not a cloud subscription managed by someone else's infrastructure.

ctaBand.heading: Built for professionals who can't compromise.
ctaBand.sub: Join the waitlist and be among the first wealth managers to access Valore when it opens to new clients.

consolidation.title: Multi-bank consolidation
consolidation.description: Import statements from any custodian via PDF or XLSX. All positions in one place, regardless of institution.

offline.title: Local-first. Offline by design.
offline.description: No data ever leaves your machine. No cloud dependency, no connectivity requirement — full control remains with you.

compliance.title: Compliance & KYC tracking
compliance.description: Monitor regulatory obligations, document status, and client risk profiles across your entire book.

portfolio.title: Unified portfolio view
portfolio.description: See every position, across every custodian, for every client — aggregated in real time. Allocation, valuation, and exposure at a glance.

kpis.title: Dashboard KPIs
kpis.description: Track AUM, P&L year-to-date, asset allocation breakdowns, and custodian-level summaries from a single command centre.

research.title: Asset research
research.description: Query cross-client exposure to any security, sector, or geography. Understand concentration risk before it becomes a problem.

multilang.title: Multi-language
multilang.description: Full interface support for English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese — with consistent terminology across all language variants.

theme.title: Dark & light theme
theme.description: A thoughtfully designed interface in both dark and light modes, optimised for extended daily use across varying display environments.

product.heading: Precision tools for private wealth.
product.sub: A complete wealth management system for independent advisors and private banks — built around consolidation, privacy, and professional-grade reporting.

consolidation.heading: One view across all custodians.
consolidation.body: Private clients rarely hold assets with a single institution. Valore accepts custody statements from any bank, broker, or custodian — in PDF or XLSX — and resolves them into a unified ledger. No manual reconciliation. No spreadsheets.
consolidation.bullet1: Automatic position normalisation across statement formats
consolidation.bullet2: Historical import for accurate P&L calculation

privacy.heading: Private by architecture, not by policy.
privacy.body: Valore processes everything locally. There are no user accounts, no servers, and no outbound connections during operation. Your client data never transits a network you don't own.
privacy.bullet3: No crash reporting, analytics, or telemetry

compliance.heading: Regulatory obligations, organised.
compliance.body: KYC documentation, suitability assessments, and review cycles are tracked per client with automatic expiry notifications. Compliance status is surfaced in the main dashboard, not buried in a separate module.
